name: Mera Manami
source:
One of the "dead" who became Teru's companion.

A mid-twenties wife with a child. She has a baby face, a large bust, and a gentle and inclusive character. She dislikes conflict and is weak when it comes to violence and seeing blood.

During the day, while her child is at the daycare, she works part-time, as both she and her husband are working. She loves her husband and child and is very faithful.

"Count me out... We're talking about murder here, aren't we?"

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
